description: Courier collection: tracking flows vs customs-fee fraud.

samples.message: Your parcel AWB 4829163750 is out for delivery today via Delhivery. Expected delivery by 6 PM. Track with your tracking ID.
Delivered: your Amazon order arrived at 2:40 PM and was handed to security. Rate your delivery experience.
Pickup scheduled for tomorrow between 10 AM and 1 PM. Keep the shipment packed and share the OTP with our executive on arrival.
Your parcel is held at customs. Pay Rs.2,500 clearance fee at the link within 3 hours or it will be destroyed!
Delivery failed: wrong address. Update your address and pay Rs.50 re-delivery charge here: http://bit.ly/dlvr-91
Shipment delayed due to weather. Revised delivery date 14th September. Track on the official site. Sorry for the inconvenience.
Congratulations! A parcel with Rs.1,00,000 cash prize arrived in your name. Pay Rs.3,000 customs duty to claim it today.
Return pickup for order 482-916-3750 arranged for Friday. Refund will credit to source account in 5 days.
